title: Extract interleaved LZ chains
changes: Extend the observed LZ, tilemap descriptor and row resources with seven linked interleaved chains, preserving encoded source, decoded data, opaque fields, source routing and guest indexing.
validation: Source e201-interleaved-source-w13041vc independently authenticates seven rows, descriptors, wrappers and 4123 encoded LZ bytes decoding to 5728 bytes. Wine e201-chain-wine-0vq42lsj preserves 120 other resources, rejects missing dependencies/coherent edits, checks altered mirrors/mixed owner boundaries and compares seven original SWI/HLE cases and 28 interpreter/native readers with equal full state and guest clock.
Wine e201-chain-cli-wine-7l8ix18e creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: The reader log contains a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful completion; the Wine host defect is tracked separately. Ordinary use, real-BIOS/DMA paths, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were performed.
